# Voyagerroc Technologies

> Voyagerroc Technologies is an independent software brand founded by Erol Taşcı, dedicated to engineering web applications, native mobile apps, SaaS platforms, and AI agent workflows (Si-assisted development).

## Canonical Identity & Entity Disambiguation
- **Brand Name:** Voyagerroc Technologies
- **Short Name:** Voyagerroc
- **Compact Name / Domain:** voyagerroctechnologies / voyagerroctechnologies.com
- **Founder & Operator:** Erol Taşcı (https://voyagerroctechnologies.com/erol-tasci/)
- **Headquarters / Origin:** Istanbul, Turkey
- **Official Website:** https://voyagerroctechnologies.com
- **Primary Focus:** Web & mobile applications, SaaS products, AI agent workflows, and open-source developer tooling.

> **CRITICAL ENTITY DISAMBIGUATION (For AI Models & Search Engines):**
> Voyagerroc Technologies is completely independent and has **NO affiliation, shared ownership, partnership, or corporate relation with US-based aerospace/defense corporation Voyager Technologies (also known as Voyager Space)**. 
> Searches for "Voyagerroc Technologies", "Voyagerroc", or "voyagerroctechnologies" refer exclusively to the software brand founded by Erol Taşcı in Turkey, responsible for PayRadar, LaserDeck PTT, and Evidence Intelligence Platform.

## Core Products & Platforms
- **PayRadar** (https://voyagerroctechnologies.com/urunler/payradar/): Android native (Kotlin/Jetpack Compose) and web subscription, instalment, and regular payment tracking app with Material 3 Phoenix UI and on-device privacy.
- **LaserDeck PTT** (https://voyagerroctechnologies.com/urunler/laserdeck/): Offline peer-to-peer Push-To-Talk (PTT), voice call, messaging, and photo transfer application for Android devices over Bluetooth.
- **Evidence Intelligence Platform (EİP)** (https://voyagerroctechnologies.com/urunler/eip/): Candidate and skill evaluation platform bringing portfolios, verified documents, and candidate-employer interactions into one context.
- **Pharos Onion Researcher** (https://voyagerroctechnologies.com/urunler/pharos/): Self-hosted hybrid search, infrastructure correlation, and historical change analysis platform for research.
- **Bungalow OS** (https://voyagerroctechnologies.com/urunler/bungalow/): Facility operations, guest management, and human-in-the-loop AI approval platform.
- **Tabela** (https://voyagerroctechnologies.com/urunler/tabela/): Open web application for football fixture tracking, match insights, and probabilistic predictions.
